title: OpenDEA Benchmark Cohort
description: A governed comparison population (CR-AM-06 §6, §7). A BenchmarkCohort defines the semantic dimensions, eligibility criteria, temporal boundary, and governance under which a set of AssessmentResults may legitimately be compared. The benchmark exists BETWEEN comparable results, not inside an individual organization (CR-AM-06 §7). This schema defines eligibility and membership only — no percentile, rank, quartile, or peer-position computation (CR-AM-06 §10; those belong to CR-AM-07).

definition.description: What this cohort IS (CR-AM-06 §6). Example: 'Telecom Operators + Service Assurance + Closed Loop Automation + Automation Coverage + AOMM v1 + 2026'.

population_segment.description: The organizational segment this cohort compares (e.g. 'telecom-operators').

scope_note.description: Free-text clarification of what is in scope and out of scope for this cohort.

eligibility_criteria.description: The explicit rules an AssessmentResult must satisfy to participate (CR-AM-06 §6, §8). All criteria are evaluated by the eligibility engine; failures produce machine-actionable reasons (vocabulary/eligibility-reasons.yaml).

minimum_confidence.description: Minimum result confidence required for membership.

minimum_evidence_records.description: Minimum count of evidence records the result must carry.

minimum_coverage.description: Minimum assessment coverage fraction (0..1) the result must demonstrate.

required_compatibility.description: Required six-axis compatibility declaration of any participating result (CR-AM-02 §11, CR-AM-06 §9).

conditions.description: Explicit conditions under which a result may participate as 'provisional' rather than 'eligible' (CR-AM-06 §4). Empty array means no provisional pathway exists for this cohort.

comparability_key.description: The canonical comparability identity required of every member result (CR-AM-06 §5). A result joins this cohort only if its comparability key is compatible on every dimension.

population.description: The membership of this cohort. Membership is a governed determination (CR-AM-06 §15): ineligible results cannot silently enter (CR-AM-06 §14).

members.description: References to AssessmentResults determined eligible (or provisional under declared conditions) for this cohort.

minimum_sample_size.description: Minimum eligible membership required before this cohort may be used for comparison (CR-AM-06 §6). A cohort below minimum sample size exists but produces no benchmark.

temporal_boundary.description: The comparison window (CR-AM-06 §6, §8). Results whose assessment period falls outside this boundary are 'expired' for this cohort.

governance.description: Who owns and reviews this cohort (CR-AM-06 §6).

owner.description: Accountable party for cohort definition and membership decisions.

review_date.description: Next scheduled review of cohort definition.
